transcript.text: If you're working leads and you get
ghosted at any part in the sales cycle,
just send them a meme. Like there's the
Kevin Hart meme where he's like, "Where
you at?" It actually has the highest
response rate out of any messages that
we've sent. You can just send that to
your cold pipeline, send it to 200 guys,
uh, and you'll probably get five to 10
that just re-engage off of that.
